verdicts.reason: A is just a shrunk copy of the square: the quote is small, the attribution and SOLSTICE logo wordmark are illegible at this size, the big maroon circle crowds into the quote line, and the left half below the text is dead space. B actually rearranges into a banner, with the quote readable beside a large quote mark, but the hierarchy is wrong: the attribution is set huge and bold, competing with the quote. The quote also wraps into a narrow column of 2–3 words per line, and the product can is shrunk to a tiny icon floating in its circle.
